name: Elmira “Ella” Bell
notes: Mother of Emma Virginia Bell (McKeldin). Elmira in the 1900 census (aged 42) and Ella in 1920 (aged 62), born in Maryland. Her birth surname is not recorded; Margaret Clayhardy, 73, lived with the family in 1900 as William Bell's mother-in-law, which suggests Elmira was born a Clayhardy (not confirmed).
